半打空间专注新型模块化集成建筑，将研发、设计、制造、销售与安装连接在一起。以混凝: Semi-Six Modular brings research, design, manufacturing, sales and installation together. Concrete walls, functional modules and timber roofs form spaces for homes, hospitality and modular projects.
公司于2025年在广东江门成立，广东志特装配科技有限公司参股，为制造协同与产业资: Established in Jiangmen, Guangdong in 2025, the company is partly owned by Guangdong GETO Prefabricated Technology Co., Ltd, supporting manufacturing collaboration and access to industry resources.
从一片预制墙板，到一个完整的空间模块，我们关注材料、结构和使用之间的连接。建筑的: From a precast wall panel to a complete room module, we consider the connections between material, structure and use. The details of a building take shape in the factory.
将研发、设计、制造与安装衔接，协调构件、模块与现场工作。: Connecting research, design, manufacturing and installation to coordinate components, modules and work on site.

持续探索预制混凝土构件、功能模块与组合建造，以项目实践推动细节完善。: Ongoing work with precast concrete, functional modules and hybrid construction, refined through project experience.
